records.name: Commander Shepard
records.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2 (2010), default male Soldier Shepard
records.sourceReference: ME2 Soldier has Adrenaline Rush and Concussive Shot and can use the M-8 Avenger assault rifle. Adrenaline Rush is adapted to a short bounded personal attack buff; the global simulation clock is unchanged. Concussive Shot is the ordinary single-target combat shot, not the optional Concussive Blast area evolution. Cover is personal physical protection. No ME3 omni-blade, Adept Singularity, Sentinel Tech Armor, Mako attack or inherited caller class power.
records.version: Mass Effect 2 (2010), default male Soldier Shepard
records.prompt:

Broad athletic military build. Hold the angular black/grey M-8 AVENGER assault rifle in both hands, stock against shoulder and clear short horizontal barrel. Use the attached old sprite for identity/armor only; REMOVE its ME3 orange omni-blade. No Sentinel field, biotic hand power, Mako or vehicle.
